newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks slump at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks slump at lower levels.

text.p: U.S. shares wallowed at lower levels on Thursday, bruised by profit-taking which eroded some of the stock market's recent sharp gains.
The Dow Jones Industrial average, which had surged when Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan gave an upbeat testimony on the economy, was down 62 points at 8027.
The long bond, strong at the start of the morning, lost 4/32 to yield 6.44 percent and the Nasdaq composite was down around six points at 1562.
